meta.title: Trucker: road freight across the Gulf
meta.description: Trucker is a planned road freight platform for shippers, carriers, vehicle owners and drivers, in English, Arabic and Urdu.

environment.development: Development build. Not a live service. All content is sample content.

hero.title: Road freight across the Gulf, one signed step at a time
hero.lead: Shipper, carrier and driver work from the same record, from pick-up to proof of delivery. In English, Arabic and Urdu.

example.title: Dubai to Riyadh
example.label: Illustration
example.note: The shipper, the carrier and operations read this same list. Each step shows who signed it and when.

items.title: Post the load
items.text: Describe the goods, the sites and the time windows once.

items.title: Compare offers and book
items.text: Verified carriers quote. You accept one, with the price and terms fixed.

items.title: Follow each signed step
items.text: The driver signs every milestone, even without signal.

items.title: Confirm proof of delivery
items.text: Photos and the receiver's signature close the job.

items.title: Shippers
items.text: Describe a load once, compare offers on the same terms and follow every step to delivery.

items.title: Carriers
items.text: See loads that fit your fleet and the routes you are permitted to run. Assign truck, trailer and driver.

items.title: Drivers and vehicle owners
items.text: One clear next step at every stop. Steps are saved on the phone when there is no signal.

languages.title: The same sign in three languages
languages.lead: Every screen is designed in English, Arabic and Urdu. Arabic and Urdu read right to left; numbers, plates and references stay left to right.

footer.note: Draft copy. The service described is planned, not live. Launch countries and routes are not decided.

signIn.title: Sign in or register
signIn.lead: Enter your mobile number. We send a one-time code to it. If the number is new, you continue to registration.
signIn.phoneHint: Start with + and the country code, for example +971 5X XXX XXXX.
signIn.phoneNote: Any country's number can be used. The country of the number does not decide what your company may do.

code.title: Enter the code
code.codeHint: 6 digits. The code works once and for a few minutes only.
code.resendNote: A new code replaces the old one.
code.developmentText: No text message is sent in this build. The code is {code}.

register.title: Finish registration
register.lead: Tell us your name. Your mobile number is already confirmed.
register.nameHint: As you want other people on Trucker to see it.
register.emailHint: For contact only. It is not used to sign in or to recover your account.

verify.title: Verification
verify.lead: Trucker staff review an organisation before it can trade. You submit its details with the evidence entries asked for, and see the outcome here.
verify.demoNotice: Demonstration only. The requirements shown are fictional test data, not any country's real requirements. What you type are your own declarations: no document is uploaded or checked. A verification given on them does not allow publication in production.

next.draft: Enter the evidence details below and submit.
next.submitted: Staff will review it and the outcome will appear on this page. While it is under review the organisation's details cannot be changed. You can withdraw the application.
next.claim_review: This application needs a further review by staff. Nothing more is needed from you now.
next.changes_requested: Correct the organisation's details or the evidence entries, then submit again. Earlier versions are kept.
next.rejected: You can correct the details and submit again as a new version. Earlier versions are kept.
next.verified: To change the legal name, country or registration number, propose the change below. It takes effect only if staff approve it.
next.verification_withdrawn: Staff withdrew the verification. New commercial actions are blocked; existing work is not cancelled. You can submit again.
next.amendment: A change to the legal identity is under review. Until it is approved, the approved identity stays in force.

verify.closed: Verification is not open for this organisation's country in this environment, so nothing can be submitted.

verify.shipperApplyLead: Your organisation is verified as a carrier. To publish shipments it also needs the shipper capability, decided by staff on its own.

pub.publishLead: Publishing uses the saved draft above: save any changes first. Your organisation must be verified.
pub.fictionalNotice: Development only. These categories and equipment types are fictional test data, not an approved catalogue.
pub.dangerousHint: A shipment with dangerous goods cannot be published at this stage.
pub.areaHint: Carriers would see this instead of the address.
pub.deadlineHint: Time at the pick-up place ({zone}). It must be before pick-up starts.
pub.deadlineNoZone: Choose the pick-up country and time zone above and save the draft first.

notice.published: Published as version {n}. Quotations close at the deadline.
notice.suspended: Suspended. Carriers could not find it and no new quotation would be accepted. Nothing is cancelled. It is no longer suspended only when every cause below has passed again, before the deadline.
notice.withdrawn: Withdrawn. This cannot be undone. To publish again, make a new draft from a copy.
notice.expired: The quotation deadline has passed. You can publish it again with a new deadline, or make a new draft from a copy.

causes.verification: Your organisation's verification was withdrawn or no longer allows publication.
causes.route: The route is not open in this environment.

pub.noCarrierYet: Verified carriers whose declared service matches can see this shipment, as shown in the preview below.
pub.previewLead: Verified carriers whose declared countries and equipment match this shipment see exactly this while it is published.
pub.previewHidden: Hidden from carriers: the exact addresses, access notes, your reference and your organisation's name. Your organisation is shown only as "verified shipper".
pub.previewCaution: What you write in the description, packaging, equipment notes and areas is shown as written. If it names your company, a person or a contact, carriers would see that. Anonymity is not guaranteed.
pub.changeLead: A change to what carriers would see, to the deadline or to the dangerous-goods answer makes a new version. Your reference, the addresses and the access notes change without a new version.
pub.withdrawNote: Withdrawing is final. To publish again you make a new draft from a copy.
pub.republishLead: Every check is made again. Choose a new quotation deadline.
pub.copyNote: Makes a new private draft with the same details, without a deadline.

carrier.matchingNote: The countries and equipment types you declare are used only to match shipments to you. They are not verified vehicles, they do not show availability, and they do not give permission to accept work.
